title: sk1nx's Player Logger
description: A simple mod that helps you avoid blacklisted people on servers and therefore help prevent unnecessary deaths.
body: A simple player logger for Minecraft. What it does: lets you blacklist / whitelist players, to get notified of their presence later on. Example: You blacklist a player named "Noob123", and enable autolog. Then, you whitelist a player named "Pro123". Now, whenever Noob123 joins the server, you will get kicked and won't be able to join back until they leave the server (toggleable from the kick screen). But when Pro123 joins, you will get notified that they joined, but will not get kicked. For the full list of commands, do "-help".
